Get early access
New: instant payouts in 38 countries

Get paid for your work in days, not months.

Fernway is the payment app for freelancers and small studios. Send an invoice, and we pay you up to 90% of it the same day. Your client pays us later. No paperwork, no bank visits.

Free for your first 10 invoices. No credit card needed.

Invoice #1042 paid$4,250.00Arrived 3 hours after sending
Freelancers paid this month61,480

Backed by investors behind 40+ fintech companies

NorthwindARC VenturesBaselineSeedhouseKinfolk VC

Everything you need to stop chasing payments.

We built Fernway after years of freelancing ourselves, waiting 60 days for a $3,000 invoice to clear.

Same-day cash for any invoice

Upload an invoice or create one in the app. Once your client approves it, up to 90% lands in your account the same day, for a flat 1.5% fee.

3 hrs

Average payout time

Most payments arrive before lunch.

Automatic reminders

Friendly follow-ups go to late clients so you never have to write that awkward email again.

Taxes, sorted

Fernway sets aside tax from every payment and gives your accountant a clean yearly report.

Bank-level security

Money is held with regulated partner banks and protected by two-step login on every device.

How Fernway works

Set up in under five minutes. No credit checks on you, only on the client who owes you money.

1

Send your invoice

Create an invoice in the app, or connect QuickBooks, Xero or FreshBooks and pick one you've already sent.

2

Get paid today

When your client confirms the invoice, we send up to 90% of the amount to your bank the same day.

3

Receive the rest

Your client pays Fernway on their normal terms. We send you the remaining 10%, minus our small fee.

Growing fast, with the people who use it.

Fernway launched in 2024. Here's where we are today.

61kfreelancers and studios paid each month
$840Min invoices paid out early
38countries with instant payouts
4.8★average rating from 9,200 app reviews

$42M raised to date

NorthwindARC VenturesBaselineSeedhouse

Loved by people who hate chasing invoices

★★★★★

"I used to wait two months for agency clients to pay. Now I get paid the day I finish the job. It changed how I plan my whole year."

Lena ParkFreelance illustrator
★★★★★

"Setting it up took four minutes. The automatic reminders alone have saved me hours of awkward emails."

Sam OrtizVideo producer
★★★★★

"We're a studio of six. Fernway covers payroll gaps when big clients pay late. Our accountant loves the tax report too."

Maya FrostFounder, Frost Studio

Meet the founders

A team of 64 across London, Toronto and Lisbon, half of whom were freelancers before joining.

Nora Quinn

Co-founder & CEO

Leo Brandt

Co-founder & CTO

Aiko Tanaka

Head of product

Ravi Kapoor

Head of risk

We're hiring 14 people this year

Engineering, design, risk and customer support. Remote-friendly, with offices in three cities.

See open jobs

Questions

How much does Fernway cost?

Your first 10 invoices are free. After that we charge a flat 1.5% of each invoice you get paid early. There are no monthly fees.

Does my client need to sign up?

No. Your client only needs to confirm the invoice by email and pay as they normally would. Most never need an account.

Is there a minimum or maximum invoice size?

You can get paid early on invoices from $250 to $250,000.

Which countries do you support?

Instant payouts work in 38 countries, including the US, Canada, the UK and most of Europe. More countries are added every quarter.

Your next invoice could be paid tomorrow.

Join 61,000 freelancers who stopped waiting to get paid. It's free to start.

© 2026 Fernway Ltd. Payments provided by regulated partner banks.

# Startup Company

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/startup-company/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
